name: B10-0527/2026 (S&D) – Soutien à la candidature de villes de l'Union pour accueillir un nouveau pôle des Nations unies pour l’évaluation indépendante et la gouvernance éthique de l’IA
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is an opinion, not a law. The European Parliament calls on the European Commission and member states to do more to control artificial intelligence. It wants the EU to enforce its existing AI and data protection rules, bring back a planned law on who pays when AI causes harm, hold a summit on AI safety, and push for global rules at the United Nations. It also wants EU cities backed to host a new UN body on AI.

**Key points**

- Nothing changes in law yet; Parliament is asking the Commission and member states to act.
- It affects EU regulators, national governments and companies that build or use AI.
- Next: the Commission and member states decide whether to follow these requests.
